answer: Resist sybils with a path-diversity liveness bond. Each epoch the protocol picks three unpredictable peer routes and asks the agent to bounce a tiny packet along each; the returning timing plume has to match one socket's delay fingerprint. Keys that share a host leave overlapping plumes and both lose their stake. Collateral is posted in ferrous units and only matures after the identity stays above a missed-bounce nadir for two full epochs. Extra names then require distinct network stacks, locked stake, and time, not merely new keypairs.
